picks.what: Courtyard of Oberhausen Castle, panoramic photograph
picks.why: sharp color photo of the castle the city is named after; trimmed to the center of the 180° panorama to limit distortion

gaps: P0–P5: no candidates at all; P6 has no general view of the city
notes: Only four modern candidates. #3 (Gasometer seen from a Ferris wheel, 2010) is the alternative: it shows the city’s best-known landmark, but small, hazy and with the gondola frame at the right edge. #2 shows a waste incinerator, #4 the Walsum power station in Duisburg.
